body:
Hey I'm not sure if this is supposed to be here or in the ask the seniors sub-forum but anyway..

I just bought Diamond rank and its said I get a lot more in game items (I think 30+) I'm not sure where they are because I looked in the credit shop and they is nothing out of the ordinary there, I'm not sure if the payment has gone through or not yet I doubt that as I have the DIAMOND prefix, I'm not to worried but if they are somewhere I'm missing could you please point me in the right direction and if they're not there you should probably change that as it is false advertising.

Just like to point out I bought the lifetime diamond rank and that all other features seem to be there such as /go and /stats.

Thank you for your time.

- Rockyyyyy
